name: LLaVA-CC3M-Pretrain-595K
description: A curated set of ~595K image–text pairs derived from Conceptual Captions (CC3M) intended for pretraining vision–language models (used in LLaVA). The collection is used to train or fine-tune multimodal models for image captioning, visual question answering, and other vision-language tasks. It is primarily a pretraining resource rather than a standalone evaluation benchmark.
reputation: Widely used as a pretraining resource in the vision–language community, particularly for LLaVA-style models; well-known but sometimes criticized for noisy captions.
